How do I use it properly the very first time?
For your first melt, keep it simple:
Set the warmer on a level, heat-resistant surface. Keep its cord away from counter edges and hot surfaces.
Put the silicone dish on the warmer, then add wax-melt bears. The starting amount depends on the warmer: 1–2 bears for a Mini Mod or Outlet, or 2–3 for a Signature or Mod. If your starter kit has a different warmer, check its instructions for the right amount.
Turn on the warmer and set its timer, if it has one.
When you’re done, let the wax cool completely before lifting the silicone dish and popping the wax out. No extra liner is needed in the dish.
That’s it—one scent and a small starting amount make the first try easy!
